findings.title: Post-verification and dashboard return links navigate to an unrouted root path, landing users on a 404 page
findings.scenario: After Zoe (or Sara, Ali, or Mia) finishes verifying her mobile number on the web onboarding flow, the page promises to redirect her to her dashboard. Instead, it assigns the browser location to /dashboard, where React Router finds no matching route and displays the 404 Page Not Found screen. The same 404 occurs when Sara clicks 'My dashboard' after submitting a membership application or when clicking subscription buttons as a non-owner.
findings.test_needed: Mount the router at '/dashboard' with an authenticated user and assert that it redirects to the user's role-specific dashboard instead of rendering NotFoundPage.

owner_question.question: When an authenticated user lands on or is redirected to '/dashboard', where should the app send them?
options: (Recommended) Redirect '/dashboard' to the user's role-specific dashboard overview via resolveDashboardPath.
Update each caller individually to construct the role dashboard path before navigating.
Keep today's behaviour where '/dashboard' falls through to the 404 Page Not Found screen.
